name: Boiler superheater and attemperator
description: Heat exchanger that adds heat to saturated steam, usually as pendant or horizontal banks in the gas path, with a desuperheater or attemperator controlling final steam temperature. Water-tube power boilers can reach 550 C superheated steam; separate or supplementary-fired superheaters are used where gas-turbine exhaust is too cool.
